M3 measures extraction: precision and recall of (person, title) pairs on five
real pages in fixtures/labelled/. The real model is called; answers are
cached, so a repeat costs nothing unless the prompt, schema or model changed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from .cache import FileCache
from .config import ROOT, Config
from .extract import Target, extract_document
from .llm import LLM
from .normalize import canonical_role, normalize_name
from .runlog import RunLog

LABELLED = ROOT / "fixtures" / "labelled"


def _words(title: str) -> set[str]:
    return set(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", title.casefold())) - {"of", "the", "and", "our", "s"}


def same_title(expected: str, found: str, company: str) -> bool:
    """The label names this title: the same single-holder role, or all of the label's words."""
    a, b = canonical_role(expected, company), canonical_role(found, company)
    if a or b:
        return a == b
    return _words(expected) <= _words(found)


@dataclass
class PageScore:
    file: str
    expected: int = 0
    found: int = 0                  # extracted pairs, not counting optional ones
    matched: int = 0
    missed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    wrong: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    forbidden: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    detail_errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    calls: int = 0
    rejected: int = 0


def score_page(page: dict, accepted: list, company: str) -> PageScore:
    """Compare what extraction kept with the hand labels of one page."""
    score = PageScore(page["file"], expected=len(page["expected"]))
    pairs: dict[tuple[str, str], list] = {}
    for a in accepted:
        if a.claim.claim_type in ("role", "appointment", "departure") and a.claim.raw_title:
            pairs.setdefault((normalize_name(a.claim.person), a.claim.raw_title), []).append(a.claim)
    used: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    def find(label: dict):
        for (person, title), claims in pairs.items():
            if person == normalize_name(label["person"]) and same_title(label["title"], title, company):
                used.add((person, title))
                yield from claims

    for label in page["expected"]:
        claims = list(find(label))
        name = f"{label['person']} / {label['title']}"
        if not claims:
            score.missed.append(name)
            continue
        score.matched += 1
        for key in ("claim_type", "departure_scope", "effective_date"):
            if key in label and not any(getattr(c, key) == label[key] for c in claims):
                got = sorted({str(getattr(c, key)) for c in claims})
                score.detail_errors.append(f"{name}: {key} should be {label[key]}, got {', '.join(got)}")
    for label in page.get("optional", []):
        list(find(label))                               # correct if present; never counted
    for person, title in pairs:
        if (person, title) not in used:
            score.wrong.append(f"{person} / {title}")
    forbidden = {normalize_name(n) for n in page.get("forbidden_people", [])}
    score.forbidden = sorted({p for p, _ in pairs if p in forbidden})
    score.found = score.matched + len(score.wrong)
    return score


def run_extraction_eval(cfg: Config, root: Path = ROOT) -> int:
    labels = json.loads((LABELLED / "labels.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    llm = LLM(cfg, "extract")
    log = RunLog(root / "logs" / "eval-extraction.jsonl")
    cache = FileCache(root / "cache" / "llm")
    scores: list[PageScore] = []
    print(f"Extraction accuracy on {len(labels['pages'])} hand-labelled pages (labelled {labels['labelled_on']})")
    print(f"Models: {', '.join(model for _, model in llm.chain)}\n")
    for page in labels["pages"]:
        c = labels["companies"][page["company"]]
        target = Target(c["name"], set(c["domains"]), c["description"])
        text = (LABELLED / page["file"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        found = extract_document(llm, target, text, source_type=page["source_type"],
                                 doc_date=page["published"], url=page["url"],
                                 max_chunks=cfg.limits.max_chunks_per_page, cache=cache, log=log)
        s = score_page(page, found.accepted, c["name"])
        s.calls, s.rejected = found.calls, len(found.rejected)
        scores.append(s)
        print(f"{page['file']}\n    expected {s.expected}, found {s.found}, matched {s.matched}; "
              f"{s.rejected} refused by the checks; {s.calls} model call(s)")
        for kind, items in (("MISSED", s.missed), ("NOT IN THE LABELS", s.wrong),
                            ("PERSON FROM ANOTHER ORGANISATION", s.forbidden),
                            ("WRONG DETAIL", s.detail_errors)):
            for item in items:
                print(f"    {kind}: {item}")
    expected, found, matched = (sum(getattr(s, k) for s in scores) for k in ("expected", "found", "matched"))
    precision = matched / found if found else 0.0
    recall = matched / expected if expected else 0.0
    forbidden = sum(len(s.forbidden) for s in scores)
    details = sum(len(s.detail_errors) for s in scores)
    print(f"\nPairs: {expected} expected, {found} found, {matched} matched")
    print(f"Precision {precision:.0%}   Recall {recall:.0%}")
    print(f"People from another organisation stored as leaders: {forbidden}")
    print(f"Labelled claim types and effective dates that came out wrong: {details}")
    print("\nThis measures five pages, not the whole pipeline. Recall is against the labels only.")
    return 0

        "expected": [{"person": "Jeff Pinner", "title": "CTO", "claim_type": "appointment"},

        "forbidden_people": ["Ron Wangerin"]}

    assert not same_title("CEO", "Chief Financial Officer", "Robinhood")
    assert same_title("Vice President of Operations", "Vice President of Operations", "Robinhood")
    assert same_title("principal accounting officer", "the Company's principal accounting officer", "Robinhood")
    assert not same_title("principal accounting officer", "principal financial officer", "Robinhood")


def test_a_perfect_page_scores_full_marks():
    s = score_page(PAGE, [_a("Jeff Pinner", "Chief Technology Officer", "appointment"),
                          _a("Vlad Tenev", "CEO and Co-Founder"), _a("Vlad Tenev", "Co-Founder"),
                          _a("Shiv Verma", "principal accounting officer", "departure",
                             effective_date="2026-06-25")], "Robinhood")
    assert (s.expected, s.found, s.matched) == (3, 3, 3)            # the optional pair is not counted
    assert s.missed == s.wrong == s.forbidden == s.detail_errors == []


def test_misses_extras_outsiders_and_wrong_details_are_each_reported():
    s = score_page(PAGE, [_a("Jeff Pinner", "CTO", "role"),                     # right pair, wrong claim type
                          _a("Ron Wangerin", "Chief Financial Officer"),        # a customer
                          _a("Shiv Verma", "principal accounting officer", "departure")], "Robinhood")
    assert (s.expected, s.found, s.matched) == (3, 3, 2)
    assert s.missed == ["Vlad Tenev / CEO"]
    assert s.wrong == ["ron wangerin / Chief Financial Officer"] and s.forbidden == ["ron wangerin"]
    assert len(s.detail_errors) == 2
    assert "claim_type should be appointment" in s.detail_errors[0]
    assert "effective_date should be 2026-06-25" in s.detail_errors[1]


def test_labelled_fixtures_are_complete_and_consistent():
    labels = json.loads((LABELLED / "labels.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert len(labels["pages"]) == 5
    for page in labels["pages"]:
        text = (LABELLED / page["file"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        assert len(text) > 500 and page["company"] in labels["companies"]
        # Every labelled or forbidden person really is named on the saved page.
        for label in page["expected"] + page.get("optional", []):
            assert label["person"] in text, (page["file"], label["person"])
        for name in page.get("forbidden_people", []):
            assert name in text, (page["file"], name)
    assert sum(len(p["expected"]) for p in labels["pages"]) == 11

"""Re-check every stored claim against the saved page it came from. No model, no network.

    uv run python tools/check_evidence.py

For each claim in data/leadership.db: the evidence quote must be in the cached
page, the person's full name must be in it, and the quote must be next to the
name. Also checks that every role marked current has a supporting claim.
Exit code 1 if anything fails.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from leadership.cache import FileCache  # noqa: E402
from leadership.db import connect  # noqa: E402
from leadership.extract import ExtractedClaim, Target, check_claim  # noqa: E402
from leadership.sources.web import clean_text  # noqa: E402


def main() -> int:
    conn = connect(ROOT / "data" / "leadership.db")
    pages = FileCache(ROOT / "cache" / "pages")
    texts: dict[str, str] = {}
    failures = total = 0
    for company in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM companies ORDER BY id").fetchall():
        target = Target(company["name"], {company["domain"]})
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT cl.*, p.full_name, s.url FROM claims cl JOIN people p ON p.id = cl.person_id
                 JOIN sources s ON s.id = cl.source_id WHERE cl.company_id = ? ORDER BY cl.id""",
            (company["id"],)).fetchall()
        bad = 0
        for r in rows:
            if r["url"] not in texts:
                hit = pages.get(r["url"])
                texts[r["url"]] = clean_text(hit["body"]) if hit and hit.get("body") else ""
            claim = ExtractedClaim(person=r["full_name"], organization=company["name"],
                                   claim_type=r["claim_type"], raw_title=r["raw_title"],
                                   value=r["value"], evidence=r["evidence"])
            reason = "the page is not in the cache" if not texts[r["url"]] else \
                check_claim(claim, texts[r["url"]], target)
            if reason:
                bad += 1
                print(f"  FAIL claim {r['id']} ({r['full_name']} / {r['raw_title']}): {reason}\n       {r['url'][:100]}")
        orphans = conn.execute(
            """SELECT count(*) FROM roles r WHERE r.company_id = ? AND r.status = 'current'
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claims c WHERE c.id = r.supporting_claim_id)""",
            (company["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        current = conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM roles WHERE company_id = ? AND status = 'current'",
                               (company["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        versions = conn.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT extraction_version) FROM claims WHERE company_id = ?",
                                (company["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        print(f"{company['name']:<12}{len(rows):>4} claims re-checked, {bad} failed; {current} current roles, "
              f"{orphans} without a supporting claim; {versions} extraction version(s) in use")
        total += len(rows)
        failures += bad + orphans
    print(f"\n{total} claims checked: {failures} problems")
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Re-check every stored claim against the saved page it came from. No model, no network.

    uv run python tools/check_evidence.py

For each claim in data/leadership.db: the evidence quote must be in the cached
page, the person's full name must be in it, and the quote must be next to the
name. Also checks that every role marked current has a supporting claim.
Exit code 1 if anything fails.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from leadership.cache import FileCache  # noqa: E402
from leadership.db import connect  # noqa: E402
from leadership.extract import ExtractedClaim, Target, check_claim  # noqa: E402
from leadership.sources.web import clean_text  # noqa: E402


def main() -> int:
    conn = connect(ROOT / "data" / "leadership.db")
    pages = FileCache(ROOT / "cache" / "pages")
    texts: dict[str, str] = {}
    failures = total = 0
    for company in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM companies ORDER BY id").fetchall():
        target = Target(company["name"], {company["domain"]})
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT cl.*, p.full_name, s.url FROM claims cl JOIN people p ON p.id = cl.person_id
                 JOIN sources s ON s.id = cl.source_id WHERE cl.company_id = ? ORDER BY cl.id""",
            (company["id"],)).fetchall()
        bad = 0
        for r in rows:
            if r["url"] not in texts:
                hit = pages.get(r["url"])
                texts[r["url"]] = clean_text(hit["body"]) if hit and hit.get("body") else ""
            claim = ExtractedClaim(person=r["full_name"], organization=company["name"],
                                   claim_type=r["claim_type"], raw_title=r["raw_title"],
                                   value=r["value"], evidence=r["evidence"])
            reason = "the page is not in the cache" if not texts[r["url"]] else \
                check_claim(claim, texts[r["url"]], target)
            if reason:
                bad += 1
                print(f"  FAIL claim {r['id']} ({r['full_name']} / {r['raw_title']}): {reason}\n       {r['url'][:100]}")
        orphans = conn.execute(
            """SELECT count(*) FROM roles r WHERE r.company_id = ? AND r.status = 'current'
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claims c WHERE c.id = r.supporting_claim_id)""",
            (company["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        current = conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM roles WHERE company_id = ? AND status = 'current'",
                               (company["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        versions = conn.execute("SELECT count(DISTINCT extraction_version) FROM claims WHERE company_id = ?",
                                (company["id"],)).fetchone()[0]
        print(f"{company['name']:<12}{len(rows):>4} claims re-checked, {bad} failed; {current} current roles, "
              f"{orphans} without a supporting claim; {versions} extraction version(s) in use")
        total += len(rows)
        failures += bad + orphans
    print(f"\n{total} claims checked: {failures} problems")
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""One-off patch: dates must be stated next to the quote; one written name is one person per document."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(sys.argv[1])


def patch(path, pairs):
    p = root / path
    s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert s.count(old) == 1, (path, old[:60], s.count(old))
        s = s.replace(old, new)
    p.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


patch("leadership/extract.py", [
 ('''        if self.effective_date:
            self.effective_pending = False              # a stated date is not "pending"
        return self''',
  '''        if self.claim_type not in ("appointment", "departure"):
            # Only a change has an effective date. "CEO since 2019" is a role, not a dated event.
            self.effective_date, self.effective_pending = None, False
        if self.effective_date:
            self.effective_pending = False              # a stated date is not "pending"
        return self'''),
 ('''            if c.effective_date and not date_is_stated(c.effective_date, text):
                # The model completed "since May 2020" into a day. A date is kept only
                # when the document itself states it in full.''',
  '''            if c.effective_date and not date_is_stated(c.effective_date, around(c.evidence, text)):
                # The model completed "since May 2020" into a day, or took a date from
                # another part of a long filing. A date is kept only when the document
                # states it in full, in or next to the evidence quote.'''),
 ('''                          reason="the document does not state this date in full")''',
  '''                          reason="the document does not state this date in full next to the quote")'''),

  '''def around(evidence: str, text: str) -> str:
    """The evidence quote with the text just before and after each place it occurs."""
    plain, quote = squash(text), squash(evidence).strip('"').strip()
    found, at = [], -1
    while quote and (at := plain.find(quote, at + 1)) != -1:
        found.append(plain[max(0, at - NEAR_CHARS):at + len(quote) + NEAR_CHARS])
    return " ... ".join(found)


def date_is_stated(iso: str, text: str) -> bool:'''),
